brief21.title: 1. Tree of Knowledge: Worldly System
notes: Centred on self, judging right and wrong itself
Its own master, no longer depending on God
Outcome: fear, shame, death
“You will be like God, knowing good and evil” Genesis 3:5
Key points:
• יָדַע, “knowing” good and evil, means taking hold and deciding, not just recognising.
• That is not a “tree of knowledge” but a “tree of setting my own standard”.
• Picture: two pot plants, an artificial one and an ivy — the difference is whether there are roots.
• Deci and Ryan’s self-determination theory: autonomy is not independence.
• Quote John 15:5 and 8:36.

brief21.title: 2. Sin Is Taking the Wrong Position
notes: Sin is not just doing wrong
It is leaving our originally intended position
God should be God, but man wants to be God
Five “I will”s (Isaiah 14:13–14)
Key points:
• “Sin”, Greek ἁμαρτία, originally meant missing the centre of the target.
• Read the five “I will”s of Isaiah 14:13–14.
• Satan planted his own virus in the human race (Genesis 3:5).
• 321: pride is leaving our originally intended position; humility is returning to it.

brief21.title: 2. Covering of Leaves, Garments of Skin
notes: Man sewed leaves into coverings for himself (Genesis 3:7)
God made garments of skin to clothe them (Genesis 3:21)
Leaves wither; skins required a death
Apart from shedding of blood there is no remission (Hebrews 9:22)
Key points:
• Read Genesis 3:7, noting the words “for themselves”.
• Fig leaves wither: image, excuses and busyness never last.
• Read Genesis 3:21; the thread of blood runs all the way to Golgotha.
• Quote Hebrews 9:22.
• Adam shifts the blame to his wife, then to God (Genesis 3:12), the first self-justification; Festinger’s theory of cognitive dissonance (1957).

brief21.title: 3. Driven Out of Eden in Mercy
notes: Lest sin’s condition be fixed for ever
Cherubim and a flaming sword guard the tree
Cherubim woven on the veil (Exodus 26:1)
The veil torn in two (Matthew 27:51)
Key points:
• Read Genesis 3:22–24: man was driven out to keep the possibility of redemption open.
• Cherubim woven on the veil (Exodus 26:1, 26:31).
• Matthew 27:51: the veil is torn in two and the road opens again.
• Sum it up in one sentence: that sword fell upon Jesus.

brief21.title: 3. You Cannot Eat from Both Trees
notes: You can’t depend on God and on yourself
You can’t let Jesus be King
and be your own master too
No one can serve two masters (Matthew 6:24)
Key points:
• Picture: one branch can’t be grafted onto two trees; force it and it dies.
• Many Christians are weary because on Sunday and on Monday they’re grafted onto different trees, and both sides lose.
• Quote Matthew 6:24 and 1 Kings 18:21.
• Wegner’s white bear experiment (1987): the more you suppress, the more it rebounds.
• 321: let Jesus be King — there is only one throne.

brief21.title: 4. There Is No Third Road
notes: Not God, and not Satan,
but “being yourself”?
“Self” is Satan’s trap
Outcome: emptiness, bondage, pain
Key points:
• Expose the illusion of “being yourself”: this road doesn’t exist.
• Satan’s greatest cunning is persuading you to worship yourself.
• Solomon’s conclusion: all was vanity and a chasing after wind (Ecclesiastes 2:11).
• Picture: the monkey gripping the peanuts can’t pull its hand out; let go and it’s free.

brief21.title: 4. Four Baits and Selflessness
notes: Fame, money, status, gratification of lust
Lust of the flesh and eyes, pride of life
No longer I, but Christ in me
Key points:
• Read 1 John 2:16 alongside the three temptations in the wilderness (Matthew 4:1–11).
• All three times the Lord Jesus said, “It is written” — the Bible is my standard.
• Kasser and Ryan’s 1993 study, “A Dark Side of the American Dream”.
• Augustine, Confessions: our heart is restless until it rests in you.
• 321: selflessness is entering into the infinite (Galatians 2:20).

brief21.title: 5. The Mind of the Flesh Is Death
notes: Relying on self, living in “self”
Drifting from God, losing peace
Adam hid from God’s presence (Genesis 3:8)
Sin’s first symptom is hiding
Key points:
• Read Romans 8:6, the balance sheet of the two systems.
• “Death” is a gradual estrangement; it doesn’t necessarily happen at once.
• Read Genesis 3:8–10: the cool breeze once longed for now makes them tremble.
• Picture: a cut rose is still lovely, but already dead — it just hasn’t shown it yet.

brief21.title: 5. The Mind of the Spirit Is Life
notes: Depending on God, obeying the Spirit
Close to God, settled in heart
A tree planted by the waters, rooted by the river
Never ceasing to yield fruit (Jeremiah 17:8)
Key points:
• Read Jeremiah 17:5–8: the desert bush and the tree planted by the waters.
• Both trees meet the heat; the difference is whether there are roots.
• Harvard Study of Adult Development (since 1938, directed by Waldinger): the strongest predictor is the quality of relationships.
• 321: life first, then relationships, then ministry; first with God, then with ourselves, then with others, last with things.

brief21.title: 6. This Is a Daily Choice
notes: Not a once-for-all decision
but a choice made every day
Therefore choose life (Deuteronomy 30:19)
Take up your cross daily (Luke 9:23)
Key points:
• Read Deuteronomy 30:19 and Joshua 24:15.
• Luke 9:23’s “daily”: in the original, καθ' ἡμέραν.

brief21.title: 6. A Course One Degree Off
notes: Rely on myself, or depend on God?
Hold on to self, or lay myself down?
Control, or entrust?
No one leaves God suddenly one day
Key points:
• Picture: the one-in-sixty rule — a heading one degree off puts you over a hundred kilometres off course across the Pacific.
• No one leaves God suddenly one day; everyone drifts away one degree at a time.

• Quote Proverbs 24:16: a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again.

brief21.title: Practices (1) and (2)
notes: Identify the source system of my reactions
Is this from me, or from God?
Deliberately turn towards the tree of life
When tempted to rely on self, pray at once
Key points:
• Read out the lesson’s first and second exercises.

brief21.title: Practice (3)
notes: Refuse the deception of “self”
“I must be in control” “I must prove myself”

brief21.title: Summary of the 3-2-1 Vision
notes: Jesus is my role model, the Bible my standard
The Holy Spirit my guide; let Jesus be King
Old self self-centred, new self selfless
Mindset, life, living, relationships, ministry
Key points:
• The Three Foundations, the Two Core Values and the Goal are the system of the tree of life.

• 235 relationships: spiritual companions, spiritual parents and children, a fivefold-ministry team.

brief21.title: Closing and Call
notes: The key isn’t how much you’ve done
but which tree you live under
Choose the tree of life, and you choose life
Choose Jesus, and you step onto revival’s road
Key points:

brief21.title: Prayer of Response and Blessing
notes: Lord, I choose the tree of life
I don’t want to be my own master
